 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # Determine most common (background) and rare (foreground) colors.
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    # Map the background to zero and every other color to the former background.
    return [[0 if v == background else background for v in row] for row in grid]
"
}
